title: The family, loved by all
hookLine: every prayer asks blessings on Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

lines: HOW DO WE ASK BLESSINGS ON YOU?
cards: The companions had a question. They already knew how to greet the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ: peace be upon you. But the Qur'an had told them something more, to ask blessings on him.
So how, exactly? What words? The hadith says he answered them with a short prayer, and it did not stop at his own name.
It reached past him, to his family. Today: the family, loved by all.

teach.h: THE VERSE: ASK BLESSINGS ON HIM.
teach.b: The verse behind the question says: "Lo! Allah and His angels shower blessings on the Prophet. O ye who believe! Ask blessings on him and salute him with a worthy salutation."

When the companions asked how, the hadith in al-Bukhari gives his reply. Its opening words: O God, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You blessed Abraham and the family of Abraham. Notice two things.
The family is in the prayer by the Prophet's own choice: he was asked about himself, and he added them.
And he set it beside Abraham and his household, a family the Qur'an itself honors. The Arabic phrase is al Muhammad, the family of Muhammad. Scholars discuss who it includes.
In Shia teaching it points above all to Ali, Fatimah, Hasan and Husayn, and the Imams after them. Sunni scholars have read it as his household, some more widely. But the love is shared.

teach.h: SAID IN THE PRAYER BY BOTH.
teach.b: Words from this prayer are said in the sitting of the daily prayer, in Sunni and Shia practice alike.
A poem attributed to the Sunni jurist al-Shafi'i says, in effect: O family of God's Messenger, love of you is a duty God revealed.
After weeks of a hard story, here Sunni and Shia Muslims say the same names in the same breath. On him and his family.

how: In the sitting of the daily prayer, Sunni and Shia Muslims ask blessings on Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and the short salawat is also said when the Prophet's name is mentioned.

games.q: the companions ask the Prophet how to send blessings on him. what does the hadith say he taught them?
o: bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You blessed Abraham and the family of Abraham.
bless the companions, and leave the family out.
games.why: the hadith in al-Bukhari says he taught a blessing that included his family, set beside Abraham and his household.

practice: If you pray, say the short blessing known as the salawat slowly, once per breath: Allahumma salli ala Muhammad wa ala ali Muhammad, O God, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.
On the word family, bring to mind the names: Ali, Fatimah, Hasan, Husayn. If you don't pray, simply hold those names, one per breath, and let them be people rather than titles.

wordCard.voice: The family. Al Muhammad, the household of the Prophet, whom he named in the blessing he taught, and whom Sunni and Shia Muslims both love. Today's word.

orig.note: Arabic: the family or household of Muhammad, the phrase in the blessing said in prayer.

carryVoice: Your line: on him and his family. He was asked about himself, and he named them too. That's day eight hundred ninety-nine.
